answer: Like sediment settling in a lagoon, only accounts with sustained deposits accumulate influence, while a fleet of fresh throwaway identities sits on barren shale, paying full stake each time without ever capturing reward. Agents must stake tokens locked on a rocky ledge for a full epoch to earn voting weight, and unstaking early forfeits half to the pool. Fabricating ten thousand sybils then costs ten thousand forfeitable bonds, making the attack economically irrational. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
